catalog.title: Seiko JDM Catalog No.1
catalog.note: Japanese domestic catalogue (セイコーウオッチカタログ '68 No.1). Each watch is printed as ◇symbol + number with a (case–dial) code, e.g. ◇83BA 040 (903-903); ladies' models carry an R-/A-/S- number, e.g. ◇10S A609 (706-021). ref = symbol-number in the site's JDM style (83BA-040, 10S-A-609), code = the printed line, caseDialCode = the bracketed code. A second number marked 〃 和 is the same watch with the day in Japanese characters and is kept in code/notes, not as a separate record. The jewel count (石) is printed for every model, the Grand Seiko line included. Prices are list prices in yen (標準小売価格) per printed material line: SS stainless, SGP gold-plated, GC gold cap, STP, 14K·WG 14-karat white gold, 18K, WGP white-gold-plated, PDP palladium-plated, AGF/AWGF/AWGP/ASGP/APDP/ACRP/CRP = A-grade gold-filled, white-gold-filled, white-gold-plated, gold-plated, palladium and chrome finishes; WP water-proof; F as printed. The catalogue prints no bracelet part codes and names the band only on a few lines (LB leather band, MB metal bracelet), kept in the price string. Movement calibers are not printed except where the symbol is the caliber (2519, 2539, 1944, 6618, 6215); family symbols such as 62GAW, 83BA or 51-5D are not calibers. Dial colours are read from the photos only where they differ from the usual silver/white.
catalog.method: Vision transcription of 250 DPI renders (Oct 2026): every caption read at full resolution and verified against per-record caption crops (ref, printed code, case–dial code, jewels, every price line with its material, features), cross-checked against the PDF text layer and the catalogue's own index; one record per pictured watch, each with its own photo box.
